title: Internal derived bar realizes ordered character cup products
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring] and let $G$ be a profinite group, with $\underline G(S)=C(S,G)$. Use ordinary derived categories of internal $A$-modules [sk-def-sfb-module-objects, def-weil-abstract-derived-category], the trivial $G$-action [def-sfb-condensed-action-module], and the coefficient-universe convention [def-weil-size-convention]. Put
$$U^n=\underline{\operatorname{Hom}}_A(A[\underline G^n],A),\qquad \mathscr B=\operatorname{Tot}_{n\geq0}R\underline{\operatorname{Hom}}_A(A[\underline G^n],A).$$
Use the trivial-action inhomogeneous bar faces and the compatible nonnegative model of [lem-sfb-condensed-derived-invariant-bar]. Write $j:U^\bullet\to\mathscr B$ for the canonical underived-to-derived total map and $\epsilon:R\Gamma_{A,G}(A[0])\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathscr B$ for the normalized bar augmentation isomorphism of that node. Let $q\geq0$ and let $a_1,\ldots,a_q:\underline G\to(A,+)$ be additive condensed-group maps. Define $z\in U^q(*)$ by
$$z(g_1,\ldots,g_q)=a_1(g_1)\cdots a_q(g_q).$$
For $q=0$ put $z=1\in U^0(*)$. This cocycle gives an internal $A$-linear cochain map $A[-q]\to U^\bullet$. In $D(\operatorname{Mod}_A)$ its composite with $j$ equals
$$\varepsilon_q\,\epsilon\circ([a_1]\smile\cdots\smile[a_q]):A[-q]\longrightarrow\mathscr B$$
for a sign $\varepsilon_q\in\{1,-1\}$ that depends only on $q$ and on the sign convention of the identification $A[-1]\otimes^L_A\cdots\otimes^L_AA[-1]\cong A[-q]$ used by the cup product; it does not depend on $G$, $A$ or the maps $a_k$, and $\varepsilon_0=\varepsilon_1=1$. The connecting classes, their signs, and the unital derived cup product are those of [lem-sfb-condensed-derived-restriction-calculus]. For $q=0$ the expression is the unit. This is equality of the specified derived arrows and requires no acyclicity of $U^n$.

proof.text: Use [lem-sfb-condensed-internal-bar-resolution] to take the exact homogeneous resolution $P^{-n}=P_n$, with deletion differential and augmentation $e:P\to A$. Its coordinate change identifies an equivariant $P_n\to A$ with an internal inhomogeneous function on $G^n$. Use [lem-sfb-internal-inflation-graded-cup] for the canonical derived inflation adjunction and its cup/shift normalization. All parameter powers and coefficients remain in the specified universes.

source.place: Paragraph (3), open direct image: agent-written internal bar normalization, detailed below the blueprint unit.

proof.text: For a character $a$ put $b_a(g,h)=a(g^{-1}h)$. Additivity gives $b_a(g,k)=b_a(g,h)+b_a(h,k)$ and $b_a(ug,uh)=b_a(g,h)$. Define $L_{a,n}:P_n\to P_{n-1}$, $n\geq1$, by $[g_0,\ldots,g_n]\mapsto b_a(g_0,g_1)[g_1,\ldots,g_n]$, and put its degree-zero component equal to zero. The free internal-module property in [lem-sfb-condensed-internal-bar-resolution] extends this natural formula linearly after every profinite base change, and invariance of $b_a$ proves equivariance. For $n\geq2$, the terms deleting $g_i$ with $i\geq2$ cancel in $\partial L_a+L_a\partial$; the remaining coefficient of $[g_2,\ldots,g_n]$ is $b_a(g_0,g_1)+b_a(g_1,g_2)-b_a(g_0,g_2)=0$. For $n=1$ both components into $P_{-1}=0$ vanish. Thus $L_a:P\to P[1]$ is a chain map with the differential $d_{P[1]}=-d_P$.

source.place: Paragraph (3), open direct image: agent-written internal bar normalization, detailed below the blueprint unit.

proof.text: For $q\geq1$ compose the shifted maps $L_{a_q}[q-1]\circ\cdots\circ L_{a_2}[1]\circ L_{a_1}:P\to P[q]$; call the composite $F_q$, and put $F_0=1_P$. Induction on the number of maps applied gives, in degree $-n$ for $n\geq q$, $F_q[g_0,\ldots,g_n]=(\prod_{k=1}^q a_k(g_{k-1}^{-1}g_k))[g_q,\ldots,g_n]$; for $n<q$ it is zero. Composing with $e[q]$ gives the cocycle $f_q:P_q\to A$ with the displayed coefficient, and the chain-map identity says $f_q\partial_{q+1}=0$. For $q=0$ this is $e\partial_1=0$. The coordinate change in [lem-sfb-condensed-internal-bar-resolution] sends $f_q$ to precisely $z$; its naturality supplies the internal $A$-linear chain map $A[-q]\to U^\bullet$, including $z=1$ at $q=0$.

source.place: Paragraph (3), open direct image: agent-written internal bar normalization, detailed below the blueprint unit.

proof.text: For the character extension $E_a=A\oplus A$ with $g(x,y)=(x+a(g)y,y)$, define $\ell:P_0\to E_a$ by $[g]\mapsto(a(g),1)$. It is equivariant since $a(ug)=a(u)+a(g)$, and its quotient is $e$. On $[g_0,g_1]$, $\ell\partial_1=(a(g_1)-a(g_0),0)=(b_a(g_0,g_1),0)$. The boundary clause of [lem-sfb-internal-bar-roof-adjunction] therefore identifies the roof $e[1]L_a e^{-1}:A\to A[1]$ with the connecting arrow of this extension. By [lem-sfb-condensed-derived-restriction-calculus] its shifted adjunct is exactly $[a]$: the degree-one inhomogeneous cocycle is $a$, with its prescribed positive normalization.

source.place: Paragraph (3), open direct image: agent-written internal bar normalization, detailed below the blueprint unit.

proof.text: Write $x_k=e[1]L_{a_k}e^{-1}$ in the equivariant derived category. Their ordered shifted composite is $e[q]F_q e^{-1}$: between adjacent factors the shifted $e^{-1}$ and $e$ cancel. By [lem-sfb-internal-inflation-graded-cup], repeated cup multiplication and the shifted-composition formula give $[a_1]\smile\cdots\smile[a_q]=T_q\Phi_q(e[q]F_qe^{-1})$, where $T_0=T_1=1$ and $T_{q+1}=T_qt_{q,1}$. This is an induction, starting with the unit and with the single arrow of step 4, applying the formula with $p=q$ and the next character of degree one at each step. Hence $T_q$ depends only on the degree and fixed shift conventions.

source.place: Paragraph (3), open direct image: agent-written internal bar normalization, detailed below the blueprint unit.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-internal-bar-roof-adjunction] to $f_q=e[q]F_q$ from step 3, including the augmentation $f_0=e$. It gives $jz=s_q\epsilon\Phi_q(e[q]F_qe^{-1})$. Substitute step 5 and use $T_q^{-1}=T_q$ to obtain $jz=\varepsilon_q\epsilon([a_1]\smile\cdots\smile[a_q])$ with $\varepsilon_q=s_qT_q$. Both factors are universal signs and both equal one at $q=0,1$. For $q=0$ the roof is the identity and its adjunct is the unit by [lem-sfb-internal-inflation-graded-cup]. The comparison of [lem-sfb-condensed-derived-invariant-bar] is the specified invariant augmentation, so this proves equality of the requested derived arrows. At no point have we inverted $j$ or used acyclicity of the terms of $U^\bullet$.
